title: Intelligence offline kernel and compiler: closure after the rejected review of v0.4.0
rules: At most five agents at once (A4); each mandate works on its own branch ic/b03-<key without the B03- prefix, in lower case>, started from the branch its starts_from names.

Tests first: the mandate commits its test file with every case-map title it owns before any product change and records which of them fail on its base and why; a title that already passes is a regression guard and is said so.
A mandate never edits src/contracts/versions.ts or docs/COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md; the contract versions are bumped once by B03-INTEGRATION (D3-VER-1).

A mandate adds its sabotage mutations in its own lot file under tools/sabotage-inventory/ and re-anchors every existing mutation whose `from` text it moves; the whole inventory stays killed (175 at v0.4.0 plus the new lots).

The privacy suite (every test/privacy-*.test.ts, among them the 99 privacy acceptance tests of docs/work/PRIVACY_REPAIR_RECORD.md) stays green without weakening an assertion; a new envelope channel gets a sentinel test and a sabotage mutation in the mandate that opens it.

Focused runs only while building: the mandate's test file, the test files it touches, the privacy suite, its sabotage lot with --only, and npm run design:check. The full gate runs once, in B03-INTEGRATION.
When a mandate lands, its case-map rows lose the word PLANNED and carry the landing commit; nothing is PASS by being listed.
No provider adapter, no API key, no paid call: the model is reached only through ModelGateway and the labelled fakes (A4 Resources; the provider choice is pending).
